dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, forming a symmetrical teardrop profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor localized indentation on the right lateral margin near the mid-section; left margin appears consistently convex.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface with specular highlights along the dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple transverse linear rake marks crossing the dorsal ridge and a singular, dark triangular mark located on the mid-dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible topological depressions along the dorsal ridge corresponding with linear rake marks and a small focal indentation associated with the triangular scar.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least four parallel transverse rake marks and one distinct triangular-shaped scar anterior to the mid-point of the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharply defined, elevated dorsal ridge casting a linear shadow onto the left side of the animal's body.
